shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.near_far_scene: The meaning of the photo is NEAR versus FAR. Exactly two things of the same kind are in the photo, and they differ only in color. The near one is with the person in the left part of the photo, large and sharp. The far one stands alone in the right third of the photo, clearly farther away, against a plain wall with nothing else around it; it is in focus and easy to recognize even on a small phone screen, and its center is about three quarters of the way across the photo, well clear of the right edge. The camera is at chest height and sees the whole scene from the side, so that the space between the person and the far thing runs from left to right across the photo: an arm pointed at the far thing would be seen side-on as a long line across the photo, never pointing toward the camera. The floor and wall between them are plain and empty. There is no mirror, no picture on the wall, no shelf of objects, and no third thing of that kind anywhere.

assets.item: This one is white. / This bike is white, (turn 1)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis from behind in a courtyard, pointing down at a black bike against the far wall, with his left hand on the saddle of a white bike beside him. Keep everything exactly the same: his back, the back of his head (no face, no eyes), his body and legs, his left hand on the saddle, his clothes, the white bike, the black bike, the courtyard, the light and the camera position. Change only his right arm and his head: he no longer points; his right arm comes down and his right hand rests on the white bike's saddle next to his left hand, and he bends his head down and a little to the left to look at the white bike. Still only the back of his head shows.

reference_file.observed_description: l02 (accepted by the user): Luis from behind, back of head only, left hand on the white bike's saddle, right arm 30 degrees down pointing at the black bike on the far wall.

assets.item: That one is blue. / but that bag is blue. (turn 2)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Using the same woman (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans), create a NEW photograph in her bright living room with plain white walls and a light wooden floor. The camera is straight behind Ana at chest height and looks the same way she looks. Ana stands just left of the middle of the photo with her back to the camera, facing the blue bag: her feet, hips, chest, shoulders and head all point at it. We see only the back of her head and neck: no face, no eyes, no nose, no profile. A large RED canvas tote bag hangs from her left shoulder at her left side, close to the camera, and her left hand rests on it. Straight ahead of Ana, one BLUE canvas tote bag of the same shape and size sits alone on the seat of a light wooden chair against the far plain white wall, about four meters away, a little to the right of her head, whole, sharp and easy to see. Her right arm reaches forward and clearly DOWN toward the blue bag, about 30 degrees below level, the hand lower than her shoulder, and the index finger points directly at the blue bag; the arm, the finger and her head form one line toward it, nothing is between the finger and the blue bag, and the fingertip stays far from it. Nothing else is in the room: no other bags, furniture, pictures or objects.

reference_file.observed_description: e01: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt, white top, jeans) with a red tote on her shoulder in her living room; a blue tote on a wooden chair across the room.
